sources.snippet: Qwen3-0.6B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑0.6B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual language model with 0.6 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.snippet: This is based on the implementation of Qwen3-0.6B found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices. More details on model performance across various devices, can be found here. Qualcomm AI Hub Models uses Qualcomm AI Hub Workbench to compile, profile, and evaluate this model.
